<solution_file path="src/solution.py">
import csv
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd
from sklearn.cluster import KMeans
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler


INPUT_PATH = Path("outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv")
CITY_CLUSTERS_PATH = Path("outputs/t13_city_clusters.csv")
CLUSTER_PROFILES_PATH = Path("outputs/t13_cluster_profiles.csv")


def main() -> None:
    df = pd.read_csv(INPUT_PATH)
    raw = df.copy()

    id_cols = {"city_id", "city_name", "year"}
    indicator_cols = [
        col
        for col in df.columns
        if col not in id_cols and pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(df[col])
    ]
    if not indicator_cols:
        raise ValueError("No numeric indicator columns found for clustering.")

    # Median imputation on indicator columns only.
    work = df[indicator_cols].copy()
    medians = work.median(numeric_only=True)
    work = work.fillna(medians)

    # If a column is entirely missing, median is NaN; use 0 to keep KMeans usable.
    work = work.fillna(0.0)

    scaled = StandardScaler().fit_transform(work)

    kmeans = KMeans(n_clusters=3, random_state=0, n_init=10)
    cluster_ids = kmeans.fit_predict(scaled)

    raw["cluster_id"] = cluster_ids.astype(int)

    city_clusters = raw[["city_id", "city_name", "year", "cluster_id"]].copy()
    city_clusters.to_csv(
        CITY_CLUSTERS_PATH,
        index=False,
        quoting=csv.QUOTE_MINIMAL,
        lineterminator="\r\n",
    )

    cluster_profiles = (
        raw.groupby("cluster_id", as_index=False)[indicator_cols]
        .mean()
        .sort_values("cluster_id")
    )
    cluster_profiles.to_csv(
        CLUSTER_PROFILES_PATH,
        index=False,
        quoting=csv.QUOTE_MINIMAL,
        lineterminator="\r\n",
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
</solution_file>
